### § 276.65 CRM KANBAN WHOLE-TICKET DRAG-AND-DROP UX, PIPELINE SCROLLING & REGRESSION REMEDIATION

#### 1. Objectives & Executive Summary
- **Whole-Ticket Draggable Surface:** Transformed enquiry ticket cards so that the entire card surface is draggable (`cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing`) rather than requiring a dedicated handle button.
- **Interactive Control Protection & Regression Root Cause Resolution:**
  - **Regression Root Cause:** The initial event filter `shouldHandleDndEvent` checked `cur.getAttribute("role") === "button"`. Because `@dnd-kit/core`'s `useDraggable` injected `role: "button"` by default onto the card container `div`, the ancestor traversal reached the card itself, mistook the card for an interactive button exclusion, and returned `false`, blocking drag initiation across the entire ticket surface.
  - **Resolution:**
    1. Added `data-dnd-card="true"` to the draggable card container and updated `shouldHandleDndEvent` to immediately return `true` upon reaching `cur.dataset.dndCard === "true"`, preventing ancestor false positives.
    2. Configured `useDraggable` with semantic `attributes: { role: "article", roleDescription: "enquiry ticket" }` so the card has an appropriate semantic role and eliminates ARIA nesting warnings for child buttons.
    3. Registered `SmartMouseSensor` alongside `SmartPointerSensor`, `SmartTouchSensor`, and `KeyboardSensor` for complete cross-browser, trackpad, and automated input compatibility.
    4. Enhanced `collisionDetection` with `pointerWithin` and `rectIntersection` fallback for responsive column hover detection.
- **Pipeline Scrolling Architecture:** Resolved mouse wheel and trackpad scroll locking over Kanban tickets. Replaced restrictive `overscroll-contain` on column cards containers with `.kanban-column-cards` (`overflow-y-auto`), enabled `touchAction: "pan-x pan-y"` on card surfaces, removed `scroll-smooth` jitter, and attached a passive `wheel` event handler to the board container (`boardRef`) that seamlessly allows native vertical scrolling when a column has overflow and translates vertical wheel delta to smooth horizontal board scrolling when cards do not overflow.
- **Enquiries & Assignees API 500 Root Cause & Fix:**
  - **Root Cause:** `enquiryService.getEnquiryAssignees()` queried `where: { agencyId, isActive: true }` on `prismaClient.user.findMany()`. In `prisma/schema.prisma`, `model User` has no `isActive` field. This caused `PrismaClientValidationError` ("Unknown argument isActive"), resulting in unhandled HTTP 500 errors on `GET /api/enquiries/assignees`.
  - **Service Fix:** Removed `isActive: true` from `src/lib/services/enquiry-service.ts`.
  - **Validation Fix:** Added `emptyOrAllToUndefined` preprocessor in `src/lib/validation/enquiry-schema.ts` for `status`, `priority`, `source`, `customerId`, `urgency`, `assignedTo`, and `scope` so that default/cleared filter query parameters (`status=all`, `assignedTo=all`, etc.) safely normalize to `undefined` without validation errors.
- **Security & Lifecycle Safeguards Preserved:**
  - `CONVERTED` stage strictly guarded against direct drag-and-drop or manual movement; lead conversion remains reserved exclusively for confirmed booking creation.
  - Dropping onto `LOST` column triggers the structured `lostModalEnquiry` modal requiring standard reason selection (`PRICE_TOO_HIGH`, `BUDGET_MISMATCH`, etc.).
  - Reopening terminal leads (`LOST`/`CANCELLED`) safely clears `closedAt`, `lostReason`, and `lostExplanation`.
  - Strict tenant isolation enforced; cross-tenant access rejected with `NotFoundError` without data leakage.

### § 276.66 ITINERARY EDITOR: ACCESSIBLE DAY & ACTIVITY DRAG-AND-DROP IMPLEMENTATION

#### 1. Objectives & Executive Summary
- **Day Drag-and-Drop Sequence Ordering:**
  - Implemented intuitive, accessible drag-and-drop reordering for itinerary days.
  - Day cards are draggable from their general surface (`cursor-grab`, `role: "article"`, `data-dnd-card="true"`), with a dedicated visual `GripVertical` icon affordance.
  - The UI updates optimistically on drop, and persists the reordered sequence via `POST /api/trips/[id]/itinerary/reorder-day`.
  - Transactional serialization uses PostgreSQL advisory locks (`pg_advisory_xact_lock`), shifts intervening days, recalculates calendar dates, and ensures contiguous day sequencing with zero duplicate or orphan records.
- **Activity Drag-and-Drop Within a Day (Intra-Day):**
  - Activities within the same day can be dragged to any target index.
  - Visual drop highlights and placeholder spacing indicate destination placement.
  - Optimistic UI reordering preserves all activity properties (pricing, supplier, notes, time, location, title).
  - Persisted via `POST /api/trips/[id]/itinerary/reorder-item` with target index, normalizing `sortOrder` values to deterministic increments (`0, 10, 20...`).
- **Cross-Day Activity Relocation (Conditional Scope: Fully Supported):**
  - **Architectural Verification:** In `prisma/schema.prisma`, `model ItineraryItem` connects directly to `Trip` (`tripId`) with scalar `dayNumber: Int` and `date: DateTime?`. Days are virtual calendar partitions (`trip.startDate + (dayNumber - 1) days`). No separate day database table exists.
  - Moving an activity across days is safely achieved by reassigning `dayNumber`, recalculating the derived calendar date, and updating `sortOrder` atomically under database advisory locks.
  - Drop targets are established on both populated item lists and empty-day drop containers (`droppable-day-${dayNumber}`).
  - Validates that source and destination days belong to the same trip within trip duration bounds.
  - Zero schema migrations required.
- **Accessible Fallback Preservation:**
  - Existing `Move Up` and `Move Down` arrow button controls are 100% preserved on both Day cards and Activity cards.
  - Full keyboard drag-and-drop navigation is supported via `@dnd-kit/core`'s `KeyboardSensor`.
- **Auto-Save & Failure Recovery Integration:**
  - Integrated with the established auto-save status indicator in the editor header (`Saving order...` -> `Order saved` / `Reorder failed (Retry)`).
  - Employs request sequencing (`reorderSeqRef`) to ensure out-of-order or stale responses do not overwrite newer user adjustments.
  - Automatic rollback on server failure restores the exact previous state and presents an immediate retry action.
- **Sensor Architecture & Interactive Control Isolation:**
  - Registered `SmartPointerSensor` (8px movement threshold), `SmartMouseSensor` (8px movement threshold), `SmartTouchSensor` (250ms press delay), and `KeyboardSensor`.
  - `shouldHandleDndEvent` guarantees that clicks, text selections, and typing inside inputs, textareas, select menus, collapse/expand toggles, template pickers, and deletion modals (`data-no-dnd="true"`) never trigger an accidental drag.
  - `touchAction: "pan-x pan-y"` on card surfaces preserves normal touch and mouse scrolling.

#### 3. Concrete Defect Identified & Remediation
- **Defect:** In `src/lib/auth/permissions.ts`, `evaluateStaffPermission` checked hard-coded domain permissions in `ROLE_PERMISSION_MATRIX.AGENCY_STAFF` rather than evaluating delegable actions against `PAGE_PERMISSIONS_REGISTRY`. This caused valid owner-delegated actions (e.g. `REPORTS:EXPORT`) to fail evaluation even when granted in the staff member's permission profile.
- **Root Cause:** Invariant 3 in `evaluateStaffPermission` checked `hasPermission("AGENCY_STAFF", domainKey, actionEnum)` without first consulting `PAGE_PERMISSIONS_REGISTRY.delegableActions` and `ownerOnlyActions`.
- **Fix Applied:** Refactored Invariant 3 to locate the module's authoritative `PagePermissionConfig` in `PAGE_PERMISSIONS_REGISTRY`. If found, it checks `ownerOnlyActions` (permanently blocked) and `delegableActions` (permitted if granted in `staffGrants`), falling back to domain matrix checks only for unmapped legacy modules.
- **Verification:** All 46 tests in `test:staff:failures` passed with 100% compliance.

### § 276.68 CRM Kanban High-Density Compact Card UI Redesign

#### 1. Context & Motivation
In standard viewport heights (900px - 1000px display with top navbar, breadcrumbs, and pipeline headers), each enquiry card originally consumed ~280px to 320px in vertical height due to multiple stacked blocks (multi-line destination, separate travel dates block, independent urgency pill row, relative contact row, full-height next action container, and a two-line footer with divider). This allowed only 1 full card to fit per column before requiring manual vertical scrolling.

#### 2. Key Architecture & UI Refinements
1. **Vertical Footprint Reduced by ~55%:** Total card height reduced from ~280px down to ~125px–135px without removing any existing data attributes or capabilities.

- **Staff Financial Redaction (`src/lib/auth/permissions.ts`):** Added `financialReconciliation`, `plannedCost`, `actualCost`, `varianceAmount`, `totalPlannedCost`, `totalActualCost`, `totalVariance`, `averageVariancePercent`, `overBudgetOperations`, and `savingsOperations` to `SENSITIVE_FINANCIAL_KEYS`, and applied `toStaffSafeQuotationDTO` / `redactStaffFinancials` to `POST /api/quotations`, `PATCH /api/quotations/[id]`, `GET /api/operations/analytics`, `GET /api/operations/[id]/closure`, and `GET /api/rate-sheets/lookup`.

#### 3. Invoice Immutability & Payment/Refund Integrity
- **Invoice Protection (`src/lib/services/invoice-service.ts`):**
  - `getOrCreateInvoiceForBooking`: Acquires `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('invoice:' + agencyId + ':' + bookingId))`, filters settled payments (`[COMPLETED, REFUNDED]`), and preserves non-`DRAFT` invoices (`ISSUED`, `PARTIALLY_PAID`, `PAID`) without overwriting line items, totals, or snapshots.
  - `issueInvoice`: Locks invoice row `FOR UPDATE` and nets `amount - refundedAmount` strictly across `COMPLETED` and `REFUNDED` payments (excluding `PENDING`/`FAILED`/`VOIDED`).
  - `regenerateInvoice`: Rejects non-`DRAFT` invoices (`ISSUED`, `PARTIALLY_PAID`, `PAID`, `CANCELLED`) as immutable historical documents.
  - *Retained Sequence Discrepancy Note:* `invoiceSequenceService` continues issuing sequential `INV-0001` format (matching `DEV-04B_INVOICE_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md` Decision #18) rather than `INV-YYYY-XXXX` referenced in earlier V3 prose.
- **Payment & Refund Integrity (`src/lib/services/payment-service.ts`, `src/lib/services/finance-service.ts`):**
  - `paymentService.recordInvoicePayment`: Enforces `PENDING` receipt status for `AGENCY_STAFF` (zero balance impact + Owner notification), rejects duplicate active `referenceNumber` with `ConflictError` while allowing reuse of `VOIDED` references, and serializes balance updates under `FOR UPDATE` locks.
  - `paymentService.voidPayment`: Acquires `FOR UPDATE` locks and safely transitions `PAID` only when `totalAmount > 0`.
  - `paymentService.verifyPaymentReceipt`: Fixes broken `tx.inAppNotification` call to write to `tx.userNotification.create` (retaining mock fallback).
  - `financeService.recalculateBookingBalances` / `recordCustomerPayment` / `refundCustomerPayment`: Blocks `AGENCY_STAFF` direct settled payments at service level, excludes `VOIDED` rows on idempotency/reference lookups, syncs linked active invoices using `[COMPLETED, REFUNDED]` net of `refundedAmount`, and executes refunds under `FOR UPDATE` payment + booking row locks inside `prisma.$transaction`.

### § 276.79 Complete Staff Account Lifecycle (Deactivation, Reactivation & Session Revocation) (2026-11-26)

#### 1. Schema & Migration
- **`prisma/schema.prisma` (`User` model) & `prisma/migrations/20261126120000_add_staff_lifecycle_fields/migration.sql`:** Added additive fields `isActive` (`Boolean @default(true)`), `deactivatedAt` (`DateTime?`), `sessionRevokedAt` (`DateTime?`), and `deactivatedById` (`String?`).
- Historical records (bookings, trips, quotations, payments, customers, audit logs, and `StaffPermissionProfile`) are **never** deleted or cascade-modified on deactivation.
- **Deployment Prerequisite:** Apply `20261126120000_add_staff_lifecycle_fields` via `prisma migrate deploy` before deploying code to staging/production.

#### 2. Deactivation, Reactivation & Immediate Session Revocation
- **`src/lib/supabase/admin.ts`:** Added `revokeAuthUserSessionsAndBan(userId)` (`ban_duration: "876000h"` via Supabase Admin API, blocking logins and refresh-token renewals) and `unbanAuthUser(userId)` (`ban_duration: "none"`), both guarded by `assertNotPlatformOwner`.
- **`src/lib/auth/session-validation.ts`, `src/lib/api/context.ts` & `src/lib/auth/index.ts`:** `getRequestContext()` and `getCurrentUser()` enforce `isDbUserSessionValid()`, rejecting any user with `isActive === false`, `deactivatedAt !== null`, or a JWT `iat` (or `last_sign_in_at`) older than `sessionRevokedAt`.
- **`src/lib/services/staff-permission-service.ts`:** `getStaffPermissions()` returns `{}` (failing closed) when `user.isActive === false || user.deactivatedAt`.
- **`src/lib/services/staff-lifecycle-service.ts`:**
  - `deactivateStaffMember`: Enforces `AGENCY_OWNER` actor, same-agency `AGENCY_STAFF` target, blocks self/owner/cross-agency/`PLATFORM_OWNER`, updates DB (`isActive: false`, `deactivatedAt`, `sessionRevokedAt`, `deactivatedById`) + logs `STAFF_DEACTIVATED`, then bans Supabase Auth (returning `502` on auth failure while keeping DB safely blocked and supporting idempotent retry).
  - `reactivateStaffMember`: Unbans Supabase Auth first (leaving DB inactive on auth failure), restores `isActive: true` / `deactivatedAt: null` while **retaining `sessionRevokedAt`** so pre-deactivation JWTs remain invalid and a fresh login is required, preserves existing `StaffPermissionProfile`, and logs `STAFF_REACTIVATED`.
- **Active Staff Counts:** `entitlement-service.ts` (`STAFF_MEMBERS`), `invitation-service.ts` (`acceptInvitation` quota & `listAgencyMembers`), and `TeamManagementPanel` count active staff (`isActive: true`).

#### 3. APIs & UI
- **Routes:** `POST /api/team/members/[id]/deactivate` and `POST /api/team/members/[id]/reactivate` (both `requireAgencyOwnerContext()`).
- **UI (`src/components/team/team-management-panel.tsx`):** Displays `Active` vs `Deactivated` badges, active/deactivated member counts, `Deactivate` / `Reactivate` buttons, and `ConfirmDialog` confirmations with loading/error/refresh handling.

### § 276.85 Complete Subscription & Plan Expiry Audit — READ-ONLY (2026-11-26)

> **INVESTIGATION ONLY:** Zero database writes (`INSERT`/`UPDATE`/`DELETE`), zero subscription/payment/account mutations, zero source/env/Git changes, and zero credential exposure.

- **Verified Environment & Account Scope:**
  - Local dev (`http://localhost:3001`) connects via `.env` (`TRIPDESK_ENV="staging"`) to Staging Supabase `nsqarlegqxymqfyvfrjw.supabase.co` (`aws-0-ap-northeast-1.pooler.supabase.com`). Production was **not** touched.
  - Existing Agency Owner `tripmadeeasy.in@gmail.com` (`id: 1a5b8334-aef6-4754-83bc-8eb8b0c54151`) → Agency `cmu2g9rgq0000swtqbr5aie7x` ("TripDesk Offical Test Agnecy", `agencies.status = "ACTIVE"`).

- **Actual Database State vs. Expiry Calculation:**
  - `subscriptions` row `cmu2g9ros0001swtqzxccuj57`: Plan `"Professional"` (`₹999/mo`, `₹9,999/yr`, `durationDays: 30`), stored `status = "ACTIVE"`, `billingCycle = "MONTHLY"`, `trialStart = 2026-09-15T03:39:01.583Z`, `trialEnd = 2026-09-22T03:39:01.583Z`, `subscriptionStart = 2026-10-24T05:43:26.912Z`, **`subscriptionEnd = 2026-11-23T05:43:26.912Z`**.
  - Latest `subscription_payments` row: `cmvmauoxu0005xstqnpo1mvdl` (`₹999.00`, `MONTHLY`, `UPI`, `VERIFIED` at `2026-10-24T05:43:26.912Z`). No newer pending or verified renewal exists.
  - Read-only `DB NOW()`: `2026-11-26T11:34:20.294Z` → Subscription expired **~3 days 5 hours 51 minutes ago** (`now.getTime() >= subscriptionEnd.getTime()`). Note: comparisons use exact UTC `Date` timestamps (`getTime()`), not local/UTC midnight truncation.

- **Exact Root Cause (Split-Brain Expiry Enforcement & Missing Transition Job):**
  1. **No Scheduled or Lazy Expiry Transition:** Zero cron routes (`vercel.json` absent) or DB jobs exist to transition `Subscription.status` from `ACTIVE` → `EXPIRED` when `now >= subscriptionEnd`, so PostgreSQL permanently stores `status = "ACTIVE"`.
  2. **Auth/Request Context Ignores `subscriptionEnd` on `ACTIVE` Plans:**
     - `src/lib/api/context.ts:132-140` (`getRequestContext`) checks `trialEnd` when `status === TRIAL`, but when `status === ACTIVE` sets `canWrite = !isSuspendedAgency` without checking `subscriptionEnd`.
     - `src/lib/auth/index.ts:86-97` (`getCurrentUser`) and `227-232` (`getSubscriptionAccess`) contain the exact same omission (`hasFullAccess = true; isReadOnly = false` whenever `status === "ACTIVE"`).
     - As a result, `/api/auth/me`, `Topbar`, `AgencyLifecycleBanner` (`src/components/layout/agency-lifecycle-banner.tsx:55`), and **all non-quota `requireWriteAccess()` / `requireMemberWriteAccess()` API routes** (among 130 write-guarded routes across customers, enquiries, follow-ups, inventory, suppliers, invoices, finance payments, team, settings, and edits to trips/quotations/bookings) continue permitting writes as if active.
  3. **`subscriptionService`, `SubscriptionProvider`, and `/subscription` UI Report `ACTIVE` Professional Plan:**
     - `src/lib/services/subscription-service.ts:196-199, 312-324, 336, 350` computes `daysRemaining = 0` for expired `ACTIVE` subscriptions, but returns `status: "ACTIVE"`, `isActive: true`, and no `isSubscriptionExpired` flag; meanwhile `.catch(() => null)` swallows `ReadOnlyAccessError` from `entitlementService.getResourceUsage()`, producing `usage: { TRIPS: null, QUOTATIONS: null, BOOKINGS: null }`.
     - `src/context/subscription-context.tsx:167, 209-229` ignores `subscriptionEnd` when `status === "ACTIVE"` (`isReadOnly = false`, `canWrite = true`) and treats `usage[resourceKey] === null` as `allowed: true, limit: null` (unlimited) in `canCreate()`.
     - `src/app/(dashboard)/subscription/page.tsx:301, 387-399, 448, 739-742, 825-832` renders `ACTIVE SUBSCRIPTION`, `Professional Plan`, green `Active`, and disables renewing `Professional (MONTHLY)` (`Current Active Plan`).
  4. **Asymmetric Backend Enforcement (`entitlementService` vs. `requireWriteAccess`):**
     - `entitlementService.resolveAgencySubscription()` (`src/lib/services/entitlement-service.ts:118-122`) **does** check `now >= periodEnd` and throws `ReadOnlyAccessError` (`403 READ_ONLY_ACCESS`), so endpoints calling `checkQuota()` (Trip/Quotation/Booking creation, staff invites) and `checkFeatureAllowed()` (`GET /api/reports*`, `/api/customer-insights`, `/api/feedback*`, `/api/agency/logo`, PDF logo helper) fail closed on the backend, while all other write routes do not.
  5. **Secondary Renewal Catch-22 (`src/app/api/subscription/payment-request/route.ts:9`):**
     - Uses `requireWriteAccess()`, which will block renewal payment submission once `getRequestContext()` properly marks expired `ACTIVE` subscriptions as read-only (must allow authenticated non-suspended owner/permitted staff via `requireAgencyMemberContext()`).
  6. **Grace Period & Caching:** Zero intentional grace period exists anywhere in `src/` (`SubscriptionStatus` has only `TRIAL | ACTIVE | EXPIRED | CANCELLED`; `PAST_DUE` only appears in legacy client mock/type files). Neither `getRequestContext()` nor `/api/auth/me` caches entitlements server-side; reload/re-login does not fix access because the backend context itself omits the `subscriptionEnd` check.

- **V3 Compliance Mismatches:**
  - Expired `ACTIVE` paid subscriptions do not transition into `EXPIRED` / `Read-Only Mode` UX or block non-quota writes in `requireWriteAccess()`/`requireMemberWriteAccess()`.

### § 276.86 Subscription Expiry Enforcement — Production-Safe Correctness Fix (2026-11-26)

- **Root Cause Addressed:** Fixed the split-brain expiry bug (`§ 276.85`) where `ACTIVE` paid subscriptions with `subscriptionEnd <= now` still returned `status: "ACTIVE"`, `canWrite: true`, `hasFullAccess: true`, `isReadOnly: false` from `getRequestContext()`, `getCurrentUser()`, `getSubscriptionAccess()`, `subscriptionService`, `SubscriptionProvider`, `/subscription`, and `adminService`, and where `POST /api/subscription/payment-request` used `requireWriteAccess()`.
- **Shared Authoritative Evaluator (`src/lib/auth/subscription-state.ts`):**
  - Added `evaluateEffectiveSubscriptionState(input, now)` using exact UTC millisecond timestamps (`trialEnd` / `subscriptionEnd`), zero grace period, and fail-closed `EXPIRED` + `canWrite: false` + `isReadOnly: true` whenever `now >= end` or `end` is missing/invalid (recording safe diagnostic reasons).
- **Server Auth, Entitlements, Renewal & Admin Reporting:**
  - `src/lib/api/context.ts`: Updated `getRequestContext()` to use `evaluateEffectiveSubscriptionState()`, and added `requireBillingRenewalAccess()` (blocks `SUSPENDED` agencies, allows `EXPIRED`/`CANCELLED` agencies to reach renewal).
  - `src/lib/auth/index.ts`: Updated `getCurrentUser()` and `getSubscriptionAccess()` to use `evaluateEffectiveSubscriptionState()`.
  - `src/lib/services/entitlement-service.ts`: Updated `resolveAgencySubscription(agencyId, client, now)` to delegate to `evaluateEffectiveSubscriptionState()` and fail closed with `ReadOnlyAccessError` when `subscriptionEnd` is missing, invalid, or reached.
  - `src/app/api/subscription/payment-request/route.ts`: Switched from `requireWriteAccess()` to `requireBillingRenewalAccess()` while keeping `enforceStaffPermission(..., "SUBSCRIPTION", "manage")`, Zod validation, and Platform Owner approval workflow.
  - `src/lib/services/subscription-service.ts`: `getAgencySubscription()` now returns effective `status`, `isActive`, `isSubscriptionExpired`, `isExpired`, `isTrialExpired`, `daysRemaining`, and `storedStatus`.
  - `src/lib/services/admin-service.ts`: Updated `getPlatformOverview()`, `listAgencies()`, `getAgency360()`, and `listSubscriptions()` so expired `ACTIVE` subscriptions are reported as `EXPIRED` and excluded from active MRR/revenue.
- **UI & Client Fail-Closed State:**
  - `src/context/subscription-context.tsx`: Uses `evaluateEffectiveSubscriptionState()` for `isReadOnly` / `readOnlyReason`, and `canCreate()` fails closed (`allowed: false`) when usage data is missing instead of granting unlimited access.
  - `src/app/(dashboard)/subscription/page.tsx`: Displays `SUBSCRIPTION EXPIRED`, rose `Expired` status, `Expired On` date, `Read-Only` / `—` for unavailable usage meters, and enables `Renew <Plan> (<Cycle>)` instead of disabling the expired plan as `Current Active Plan`.
- **Verification:**
  - `prisma/test-subscription-expiry-enforcement.ts`: `34/34` passed (`1s` future, `=== now`, `1s` past, missing/invalid `subscriptionEnd`, trial boundaries, expired owner & staff read-only/write blocking, renewal route owner/staff/suspended/validation checks, active & Platform Owner regression).
  - `prisma/test-staff-lifecycle.ts` (`23/23`), `prisma/test-staff-application-wide-authorization.ts` (`137/137`), `prisma/test-staff-invitation-session.ts`, `prisma/test-phase1-security-financial-stabilization.ts`, `npx prisma validate`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `git diff --check`, targeted `eslint`, and `npm run build` all exited `0`.
  - Existing Staging agency records (`tripmadeeasy.in@gmail.com`) and Production were untouched.
